basic_profile.bio: A long-time Pittsburgh resident who’s been on Reddit for over a decade, juggling between work in audio engineering and a passion for Pokémon fan communities. I often spend my evenings exploring open relationship dynamics and sound design discussions. I work in a local recording studio and am in an open marriage, which keeps my life both busy and interesting. Typically online in the late evenings due to studio hours. I dislike misinformation and overly strict rules.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: With a degree in audio engineering from the University of Pittsburgh, I’ve spent the last decade honing my craft in sound design. My interest in open relationships stems from personal experiences and extensive reading on the topic. Additionally, I've been a Pokémon fan since childhood and enjoy discussing the Pokémon Special Manga series.
